name: pe2-animui-fix
prompt:
Kreative Studio web UI (STU-PE2, the Animation part of the Pose tab). Plain browser JavaScript, no modules, no libraries, no build step. The browser test test/e2e/anim.e2e.js failed:
walk: FAILED Expected values to be strictly equal: 0 !== 4
scrub: FAILED Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'bend')
add-remove: FAILED keys [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75] instead of [0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75]
ease: FAILED waiting for locator('#anim-timeline .anim-key[data-t="0.25"]')
play: FAILED time moves while playing: 0.012
library: FAILED waiting for locator('#anim-library .anim-card')
no-page-errors: FAILED stage is not defined | stage is not defined | stage is not defined

Review of public/js/pose-anim.js (fix exactly these, SEARCH/REPLACE edits only, change nothing else):
1. `stage` is used but never defined. Declare `let stage = null;` with the other state, and wrap everything that touches the page (the els object, window.KKAnimEditor, the event listeners and the first render) in a function setup() that starts with `stage = window.KKPoseEditor.stage;` and `clip = KKPose.anim.newClip();`. Run setup on DOMContentLoaded, or at once when document.readyState !== 'loading' (pose-panel.js sets window.KKPoseEditor on DOMContentLoaded and its listener was added first, so it is ready by then). Remove the old `if (typeof KKPose !== 'undefined' ...)` init at the end.
2. Keep window.KKAnimEditor inside setup() so els exists when error() runs.
